meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从蛋白结构和小分子结构预测结合姿态,支持批量对接与虚拟筛选
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用已知蛋白结构快速预测小分子结合位置,并批量筛选化合物库
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict small-molecule binding poses and screen compound libraries at scale

howto.what: 它会调用 DiffDock 做分子对接:给定蛋白的 PDB 文件或氨基酸序列,加上配体的 SMILES 或结构文件,预测小分子在蛋白上的 3D 结合姿态并给出置信度分数,支持单条与批量虚拟筛选。
howto.when: 当你要求把配体对接进蛋白、预测结合位点或做虚拟筛选,或提供 PDB/序列加 SMILES 时接管。不用于结合亲和力预测。

say.text: 把这个配体对接进蛋白,输出前几名姿态和置信度
say.note: 运行单复合物对接,结果按 rank 命名

say.text: 用 batch_input.csv 跑批量对接,再汇总置信度
say.note: 批量模式输出到结果目录并生成汇总

say.text: 帮我看看哪些姿态置信度高于 0,值得保留

howto.what_en: It runs DiffDock molecular docking: given a protein PDB file or sequence plus a ligand SMILES or structure file, it predicts 3D binding poses and confidence scores, and supports batch runs and virtual screening.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to dock a ligand to a protein, predict a binding site or run virtual screening, or supply a PDB/sequence plus SMILES. Not for binding affinity prediction.

say_en.text: Dock this ligand into the protein and list the top poses with confidence
say_en.note: Runs single-complex docking; outputs rank-named SDF files

say_en.text: Run batch docking with batch_input.csv and summarize the confidence scores
say_en.note: Batch mode writes to the output dir and builds a summary

say_en.text: Which poses have confidence above 0 and are worth keeping?
say_en.note: Grades poses as high, moderate or low
